senses.zh_definition: 视频；录像；录制的活动影像内容。
senses.ms_definition: = filem video filem yg telah dirakamkan pd pita video dan hanya sesuai utk ditayangkan dgn menggunakan alat video
senses.nuances: 引录的是 Kamus Dewan 的录像带时代定义；现代也普遍指手机拍摄或网上播放的数字视频，不要求实物录像带。video muzik 指音乐视频，panggilan video 指视频通话。
senses.en_definition: A recording of moving images, usually with sound, for playback on a screen.

senses.zh_definition: 录像机；用于录制和播放录像的设备。
senses.ms_definition: = alat video alat utk merakamkan dan menayangkan filem dgn menggunakan pita video (disalurkan melalui peti televisyen)
senses.nuances: 主要见于旧式家用影音设备语境。现代要明确说‘录像机’，宜用 perakam video；kamera video 是摄像机，不等同于旧式录像带播放设备。
senses.en_definition: A device for recording and playing back videotapes through a television.

senses.zh_definition: 录像带；用于保存影像与声音的磁带。
senses.ms_definition: = pita video pita bermagnet yg digunakan utk merakamkan gambar dgn suaranya sekali dr televisyen
senses.nuances: 指实体磁带，不是手机里的视频文件。脱离旧媒体语境时，单说 video 通常会被理解成视频内容。
senses.en_definition: Magnetic tape used to record moving images and sound.

etymology.root_origin: 借自英语 video，在马来语中作为完整词根使用。
etymology.historical_story: video 随英语影音术语进入马来语，在词典中留下了电视机、录像机和磁带相互连接的时代画面。如今人们用手机录制、在群聊分享的也是 video，承载影像的介质改变了，这个借词却继续沿用。
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 英语 video 直接带进马来语：merakam video 是录，menonton video 是看；前面加 pita，才明确是实体录像带。

morphology.pattern_note: 外来整词作为独立词根记忆，标准读法分为 vi.rus；与 anti-、retro- 等外来构词成分结合时，virus 的拼写保留。

senses.zh_definition: 病毒；比细菌更微小、依赖活细胞复制的感染性因子，可使人、动物或植物患病。
senses.en_definition: A microscopic infectious agent that replicates inside living cells and can cause disease in humans, animals or plants.
senses.ms_definition: Sejenis agen jangkitan yang lebih halus daripada bakteria, membiak di dalam sel hidup dan boleh menyebabkan penyakit pada manusia, haiwan atau tumbuhan.
senses.nuances: 本条采用生物学核心义。virus 指病原体，jangkitan virus 指病毒感染；病毒名称通常后置，如 virus influenza。

etymology.root_origin: 英语 virus ← 拉丁语 vīrus（毒液、毒物）
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把熟悉的英语拼写 virus 与马来语读音 vi.rus 配对记忆：字形相同，马来语按两个音节读。
etymology.historical_story: 马来语 virus 借自英语，词源可追溯到表示毒液或毒物的拉丁语 vīrus。这个词在科学用语中逐渐取得现代病毒学含义，进入马来语后保留原拼写，并形成 vi.rus 的本地读法。[马来语借词来源](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/virus)、[词义演变](https://www.etymonline.com/word/virus)

etymology.historical_story: Victor began as a Roman name associated with the Latin word for a victor or conqueror. It became established in Christian naming traditions and spread across several European languages. The same spelling therefore has both a personal-name history and an English common-noun use. Neither history alone identifies the function of an isolated token in a Malay corpus.

morphology.formula: ∅ + veer → veer（英语整词；不作马来语词缀拆分）
morphology.pattern_note: 这里采用英语动词的英式音标；美式常读 /vɪr/。ee 不按马来语逐字母拼读，r 是否发音取决于英语口音。词族所列形式均为英语屈折变化。

word_family.gloss: 英语第三人称单数现在时：转向；偏离
英语过去式及过去分词：转了方向；发生偏离
英语现在分词或动名词：转向；偏离

senses.zh_definition: 改变行进方向；转向或偏离原来的路线，常指突然或明显的方向变化。
senses.en_definition: To change direction or course, often suddenly or markedly.
senses.ms_definition: Berubah arah atau menyimpang daripada laluan asal, lazimnya secara tiba-tiba atau ketara.
senses.nuances: 这是可核实的英语常用义，不能据输入排名认定为官方马来语词；输入也不足以排除同形专名。英语搭配包括 veer off course、veer to the left。下列 ms 项提供马来语对应搭配，并非声称 veer 本身构成标准马来语搭配。马来语释义为编辑译释。[Cambridge：veer](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/dictionary/english/veer)。

senses.zh_definition: 话题、立场或发展趋势转向另一方向，尤指偏离原来的主题或路线。
senses.en_definition: To shift towards a different topic, position, or tendency.
senses.ms_definition: Beralih kepada topik, pendirian atau kecenderungan yang berbeza daripada yang sebelumnya.
senses.nuances: 这是英语动词的比喻用法。描述谈话时可译为 beralih 或 menyimpang，描述立场时须按语境选择译法。本条提供英语常用义的跨语说明，不冒充完整英语历史词典，也不宣称存在相同范围的马来语借词义。[Cambridge：veer 的话题转移用例](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/dictionary/english/veer)。

etymology.historical_story: The English turning verb veer is traced to French virer, meaning to turn. Its physical image also supports figurative uses involving conversations or opinions changing direction. English additionally has a historically separate nautical verb concerning letting out rope, so identical spelling does not guarantee a single origin. Neither history establishes a Malay borrowing. [Merriam-Webster: word history](https://scrabble.m-w.com/dictionary/veer).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 想象方向盘突然一转：车辆 veer，话题也能像车辆一样“转向”。这是语义联想，不是词根拆分。

etymology.historical_story: Vampire belongs to a European folklore tradition rather than originating as a Malay formation. Its word history reaches back to Slavic languages, while Gothic literature helped establish the blood-drinking revenant as a familiar fictional figure. Its appearance in a Malay text may therefore reflect English vocabulary or discussion of foreign fiction, without proving an established Malay borrowing. [Source](https://epublications.marquette.edu/gothic_vampirism/)

etymology.historical_story: Las Vegas means 'the meadows' in Spanish. The name recalls spring-fed grasses in a desert valley, rather than the entertainment image associated with the city today. Nevada's historical account describes the oasis as a homeland of Southern Paiute people and a stopping place for travelers. Vegas preserves part of that Spanish place name in shortened everyday use.

etymology.historical_story: Vijay belongs to a South Asian naming tradition associated with Sanskrit vijaya, meaning victory or triumph. Its use as a personal name carries that older association without making it an ordinary Malay word for victory. When it appears in Malaysian discourse, the surrounding sentence determines which person is meant. See [Vijay](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vijay_%28name%29).

etymology.historical_story: Viktor is a form of Victor used across several European languages. The older Latin name Victor carries the meaning of a victor or conqueror. As the name passed between languages, its spelling and pronunciation varied. In a Malay sentence, however, Viktor normally identifies a person; its historical meaning is background information rather than a translation. [Viktor](https://www.behindthename.com/name/viktor), [Victor](https://www.behindthename.com/name/victor)

etymology.historical_story: Vegeta illustrates how identical spellings can name unrelated cultural objects. In Dragon Ball it identifies a Saiyan prince. In food history it identifies Podravka's seasoning, launched in 1959 following development by Zlata Bartl and her team. A Malay reader therefore needs the surrounding topic to distinguish the character from the product. [Dragon Ball official site](https://en.dragon-ball-official.com/news/01_2185.html), [Vegeta brand history](https://vegeta.com/au/history-of-vegeta/).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 Vegeta 先看场景：悟空、赛亚人、手办指向贝吉塔；厨房、食谱、包装指向调味料品牌。

etymology.historical_story: Victoria comes from the Latin word for victory and has a documented history as a female personal name in Europe. Its appearance in Malay is the use of an international proper name, rather than Malay affixation. The original Latin meaning explains the name's history, but does not turn a person named Victoria into a Malay word meaning victory. [Dictionary of Medieval Names：Victoria](https://dmnes.org/2016/4/name/Victoria)

etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 想象用望远镜看见五年后的理想生活：看见的未来图景就是 visi，走向它的具体行动则需要另作计划。

etymology.historical_story: English Vince is a shortened form of Vincent, a name descending from Roman Vincentius and ultimately associated with the Latin verb meaning to conquer. Vincent spread through Christian naming traditions and later developed familiar short forms. This ancestry explains the name’s history, not the personality or beliefs of its bearer. [Vince](https://www.behindthename.com/name/vince), [Vincent](https://www.behindthename.com/name/vincent)

etymology.historical_story: Vietnam corresponds to the Vietnamese name Việt Nam, written 越南 in Chinese characters. Under the Nguyễn dynasty, Việt Nam became an official state name in 1804, although the expression had appeared earlier. Malay uses Vietnam as a complete foreign place name; its historical components are not Malay prefixes or suffixes. [Vietnam National Authority of Tourism](https://vietnamtourism.vn/en/index.php/about/items/1928)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: Vietnam ↔ Việt Nam ↔ 越南：把 Viet 与越、Nam 与南对应起来，作为国家名整体记忆。

etymology.historical_story: J. K. Rowling invented Voldemort as a name with French associations: vol can suggest flight or theft, while mort means death. Within the story, Tom Marvolo Riddle rearranges his name into “I am Lord Voldemort,” creating a grander identity. These associations connect the name with his obsession with death; they are not Malay word formation. See [the official account](https://www.harrypotter.com/features/the-different-meanings-behind-lord-voldemorts-many-names).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把读音记成“VOL-də-mort”，联想伏地魔害怕死亡；mort与法语“死亡”有关，整个名字仍作为专名记忆。

morphology.pattern_note: 按完整外来词记忆，不把末尾 -ante 分析为马来语词缀。所列 IPA 为英语参考读音，见 [Cambridge Dictionary](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/dictionary/english/vigilante)，不代表已核实的统一马来语规范读音。

senses.zh_definition: 自行承担治安或惩罚犯罪职责的人，通常未经正式授权；可带有私刑执行者、自封执法者的贬义。
senses.en_definition: A person who undertakes to prevent or punish crime without official authority.
senses.ms_definition: Orang yang bertindak sendiri untuk membanteras jenayah atau menghukum orang yang dianggap bersalah tanpa kuasa rasmi.
senses.nuances: 这是英语借用及影视评论中常见的意义，不必然指英雄。作为马来语名词时，复数可用 para vigilante 或 kumpulan vigilante。参见 [Cambridge：vigilante](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/dictionary/english/vigilante)。

senses.zh_definition: 自愿监看某地区治安的人员；在特定解释中可中性地指志愿治安守望者。
senses.en_definition: A volunteer who watches over the peace and security of an area.
senses.ms_definition: Sukarelawan yang mengawasi keamanan di sesuatu kawasan.
senses.nuances: DBP 2018 年语言咨询采用这一较中性的解释，不能据此断言该人员实施私刑。具体文本须区分志愿守望与未经授权惩罚他人。参见 [DBP 语言咨询](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=vigilance)。

cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于新闻分析、犯罪题材及影视讨论。翻译时须按语境选择“志愿治安守望者”“自封执法者”或“私刑执行者”，不宜一律译成“义警”。

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适用于新闻分析、犯罪题材及影视讨论。翻译时须按语境选择“志愿治安守望者”“自封执法者”或“私刑执行者”，不宜一律译成“义警”。

etymology.historical_story: English adopted vigilante from Spanish in the nineteenth century; its Spanish background concerns watchfulness and guarding. In English, the word developed its familiar association with people enforcing their own version of justice. The history helps explain why a Malay explanation may emphasize community watching while an English-language film uses the same word critically. See [Oxford's word origin](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/us/definition/english/vigilante).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 vigilante 与“警觉地守望”联系，再追问“有没有正式授权？”——现代影视中常指自己抓人、自己惩罚的角色。

morphology.pattern_note: 外来词整体作为独立词素记忆；词中的 -ka 不是马来语后缀。现代马来语中没有常用的本土词缀派生词，因此词族留空。

etymology.historical_story: Nama vodka berasal daripada bahasa Rusia, dengan hubungan kepada voda yang bermaksud air dan bentuk pengecil yang lazim diterangkan sebagai air kecil. Sumber: [Oxford Learner’s Dictionaries](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/us/definition/english/vodka).

etymology.historical_story: Viking belongs to a historical naming tradition connected with Old Norse seafaring and raiding. The deeper origin of the term remains debated, so the familiar explanation that it simply means a person from a bay should not be treated as settled fact. Modern historical usage also includes trading voyages and overseas settlement. [Australian National Maritime Museum](https://www.sea.museum/en/learn/resource/vikings).

etymology.historical_story: Vicky is an English familiar form of Victoria. Victoria comes from the Latin word for victory and was also the name of the Roman goddess of victory. The shorter form illustrates how personal names develop affectionate everyday alternatives. In Malay conversation, Vicky functions as a person’s name rather than as a translation of victory. [Sources: Vicky](https://www.behindthename.com/name/vicky), [Victoria](https://www.behindthename.com/name/victoria).

etymology.historical_story: Valentine comes through English from the personal name associated with Saint Valentine; the name ultimately reflects Latin Valentinus. Medieval European literature helped connect the saint’s day with romantic love. English later used valentine for both an affectionate card and a sweetheart. Malay contexts retain the name in expressions such as Hari Valentine. [University of Lincoln](https://history.lincoln.ac.uk/2019/02/13/a-history-of-valentines-day/)

etymology.historical_story: The international word visa traces through French to a Latin expression meaning a paper that has been seen or examined. That history explains its association with official inspection and passport endorsements. Malay uses the same recognizable form, although this evidence does not establish the precise language through which Malay borrowed it. etymology.historical_story: Valerie belongs to a European naming tradition connected with Latin Valeria, the feminine form of the Roman family name Valerius. etymology.historical_story: Vaksin belongs to an international medical word family ultimately linked to Latin vacca, meaning cow. The connection recalls Edward Jenner's 1796 use of cowpox material to protect against smallpox. The name later extended beyond that particular disease. In Malay, the borrowed noun supports local formations such as memvaksin and pemvaksinan, connecting an international scientific term with everyday Malay grammar. [WHO vaccination history](https://www.who.int/news-room/spotlight/history-of-vaccination/a-brief-history-of-vaccination)

etymology.historical_story: Malay borrowed vegetarian as a complete English word. Its English history is tied to nineteenth-century dietary reform: the [Vegetarian Society](https://vegsoc.org/who-we-are/history/) documents its appearance in an 1842 journal and the society's establishment in 1847. The borrowed label names a dietary identity, while Malaysian speakers can also describe the practice directly with makan sayur or mengamalkan pemakanan vegetarian.

etymology.historical_story: VIP entered Malay as an English initialism for Very Important Person. Its borrowed form remains recognisable because speakers normally pronounce the English letter names separately. DBP records the Malay meanings orang penting and orang kenamaan. etymology.historical_story: Vertigo ultimately comes from Latin vertigo, meaning a turning round, and belongs to the word family of vertere, 'to turn'. Its spinning image remains central to medical usage. Malay uses the international term as a whole word: its Latin history explains the meaning but does not create productive Malay prefixes or suffixes. [Medical dictionary etymology](https://www.tabers.com/tabersonline/view/Tabers-Dictionary/761570/all/vertigo?q=paroxysmal)

etymology.historical_story: Vedhalam represents Tamil vē tā ḷam, written வேதாளம், a word borrowed from Sanskrit vetāla for a supernatural being. The spelling also circulates for the 2015 film officially promoted as Vedalam. Its appearance in Malay conversation can therefore reflect Tamil cultural reference or a movie title, without establishing an ordinary Malay dictionary word. [Tamil lexical entry](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/வேதாளம்), [official teaser](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=b3WB7ogte-g)

etymology.historical_story: English valley entered Middle English through Anglo-French valee, with recorded English use dating to the fourteenth century. Its history belongs to English and French, rather than Malay affixation. In Malaysian bilingual geography, the useful connection is valley–lembah: the same landscape is named through two different linguistic traditions. [Merriam-Webster: valley](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/valley)

etymology.historical_story: German Vogel continues Middle High German vogel and Old High German fogal. Duden treats its deeper origin as uncertain, mentioning a possible relationship with the verb meaning “to fly.” This is the history of the German noun, not evidence that Malay borrowed it. The packet alone cannot establish why this spelling entered the supplied word list. [Duden](https://www.duden.de/rechtschreibung/Vogel)

etymology.historical_story: English very came through Anglo-French forms meaning true, ultimately connected with Latin verus. Its earlier connection with truth survives in emphatic expressions identifying the actual person or thing. The familiar degree meaning developed alongside these uses. Remembering that history helps explain why very can mean either extremely or precisely, depending on its grammatical setting. See [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/very).

etymology.historical_story: The international anatomical term vagina comes from Latin vagina, meaning a sheath or covering. Malay retains the recognizable spelling as a scientific term, while DBP defines it through faraj and liang peranakan. The historical image explains the name, but the modern anatomical meaning identifies a specific internal canal. [Sources: Lewis and Short](https://thrax.mpiwg-berlin.mpg.de/mpiwg-mpdl-cms-web/lt/GetDictionaryEntries?dictionary=ls&inputType=lemma&language=lat&outputFormat=html&outputType=dictFull&query=vagina), [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=faraj%3B).

etymology.historical_story: Vega preserves an Arabic astronomical name through medieval Latin spellings. Its source phrase is often rendered as the descending eagle, while research on Arabian sky traditions interprets the bird as an alighting vulture. The modern name therefore carries a fragment of an older cultural picture of the night sky. [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/Vega), [American Astronomical Society research abstract](https://baas.aas.org/pub/2023n2i121p01/release/1)

morphology.pattern_note: 原始词项身份未确定。车辆术语 VIN 是英语首字母缩略语，不按马来语词缀拆分；其读法不能直接用于所有 vin。

senses.zh_definition: 若原文属于车辆语境且 vin 是 VIN 的小写形式，则指车辆识别号码，即用于识别特定车辆的编码。
senses.en_definition: In automotive contexts, a possible lowercase rendering of VIN: a code identifying an individual vehicle.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam konteks automotif, kemungkinan bentuk huruf kecil bagi VIN, iaitu singkatan Vehicle Identification Number: kod pengenalan bagi sesebuah kenderaan.
senses.nuances: 这是有来源支持的条件性释义，尚不能确定为输入词项的实际含义。马来西亚车辆资料使用大写 VIN；不能据此把小写 vin 认定为正式马来语普通词。马来文释义为编辑释义，并非 DBP 原文。[PROTON 马来文车主手册](https://cms-assets.proton.com/proton-cms-blob/media/lxkjkdpx/x90_owners_manual_sept2024_compressed.pdf)

dual_scenarios.en: Please ensure that the vehicle's VIN matches the number recorded in the documents.

cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 技术文件保留大写 VIN。若 vin 实际是人名、外语词或其他标识，应依原文另行判定。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 在车辆业务沟通中，首次出现可写 nombor pengenalan kenderaan (VIN)，方便不熟悉英语缩略语的人理解。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 技术文件保留大写 VIN。若 vin 实际是人名、外语词或其他标识，应依原文另行判定。

etymology.historical_story: The automotive abbreviation VIN comes from the English phrase Vehicle Identification Number. Malaysian vehicle documentation uses it alongside Malay terminology for vehicle identification. This explains an established uppercase technical form, but it does not establish the origin or identity of the lowercase token supplied here. [JPJ vehicle documentation](https://www.jpj.gov.my/wp-content/uploads/2022/04/Garis-Panduan-VTA.pdf)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 若语境是汽车，就把 VIN 联想成车辆的身份证号码；脱离语境时，不要给 vin 强行绑定此义。

morphology.pattern_note: 整词记忆，不拆成马来语词缀；按马来语字母读音可读为 /vam.pir/，不采用英语 vampire 的双元音。数据包未提供经核实的音节划分和爪夷文，保留空值。

senses.zh_definition: 吸血鬼：传说或虚构作品中以吸食人血为生、常被描写为死后复生的人形怪物。
senses.en_definition: A supernatural being in folklore or fiction, typically a reanimated human, that feeds on human blood.
senses.ms_definition: Makhluk dalam cerita atau kepercayaan yang digambarkan hidup semula selepas mati dan menghisap darah manusia.
senses.nuances: 主要用于恐怖、奇幻和流行文化语境。此处马来语释义为编写释义，并非已核实的 DBP 原文；status 按指定格式保留，不表示已确认 DBP 收录此词形。勿将欧洲吸血鬼与马来传说中的 pontianak 完全等同，也不要套用印度尼西亚词典中未经本条核实的蝙蝠义。怪物义可参照 [Cambridge Dictionary](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english-german/vampire)。

etymology.historical_story: The international vampire word spread through Europe from Serbian vampir, with German and French helping carry it into other languages during the eighteenth century. Reports about supposed returning corpses made the term widely discussed. Its deeper origin remains debated; the immediate route by which this particular spelling entered Malay is not established here. [Historical linguistic study](https://edizionicafoscari.unive.it/media/pdf/books/978-88-97735-10-6/978-88-97735-10-6.pdf).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 vam-pir 和熟悉的英语 vampire 连起来，再想象两颗吸血尖牙：词形相近，核心意思都是“吸血鬼”。

morphology.pattern_note: 现代马来语中的完整借词，按三个音节读；不拆成马来语词缀。

senses.zh_definition: 维生素；身体维持正常生长、代谢和健康所需的微量有机营养物质。
senses.en_definition: An organic nutrient required in small amounts for normal growth, metabolism, and bodily function.
senses.ms_definition: Bahan organik yang diperlukan oleh tubuh dalam kuantiti kecil untuk pertumbuhan normal, pengawalan kesihatan dan pencegahan penyakit akibat kekurangannya.
senses.nuances: 可指食物中天然存在的维生素，也可在日常表达中指维生素补充剂。它是营养物质类别，不等同于矿物质，也不泛指所有保健品。

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 讨论别人的饮食或补充剂习惯时避免评判；日常说 makan vitamin 很自然，正式营养说明通常用 pengambilan vitamin。

etymology.historical_story: Nama vitamin berkait dengan penyelidikan penyakit akibat kekurangan zat makanan. Pada tahun 1912, Casimir Funk memperkenalkan istilah vitamine, menggabungkan unsur vita, yakni kehidupan, dengan amine kerana beliau menyangka bahan tersebut tergolong dalam amina. Apabila diketahui bahawa tidak semua vitamin ialah amina, huruf e akhirnya digugurkan. Bentuk vitamin kemudian menjadi istilah sains antarabangsa. [Sejarah istilah vitamin](https://www.vitamin-society.jp/qa/).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: vi-ta-min 对应熟悉的“维他命”：身体只需少量，却是正常运作所需的营养。

morphology.pattern_note: 整词借入，无马来语词缀；首音节 e 读 /e/，第二音节读 /ə/。下列为相关词组，并非词缀派生词。

senses.zh_definition: 退伍军人；曾经服役的军人或战士。
senses.en_definition: A former member of the armed forces or a former combatant.
senses.ms_definition: Bekas anggota tentera, perajurit atau pejuang.
senses.nuances: 一般军旅义不必然表示曾上战场；veteran perang 才明确突出参战经历。释义据 [DBP《Kamus Dewan》](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=veteran)。

senses.zh_definition: 体育等领域的老将；曾长期活跃于赛场的选手或昔日名将。
senses.en_definition: A longstanding or former competitor, especially an established sports player.
senses.ms_definition: Jaguh lama dalam bidang sukan atau pertandingan lain.
senses.nuances: 强调长期参赛经历或昔日战绩，不必然已经退役。赛事中的 veteran 组别可能另有年龄资格。

senses.zh_definition: 某行业或领域经验丰富的资深人士。
senses.en_definition: A person with extensive experience in a particular field or activity.
senses.ms_definition: Orang yang mempunyai banyak pengalaman dalam sesuatu bidang atau perkara.
senses.nuances: 可置于职业名词之后，突出资历，如 pelakon veteran；这类用法不表示具有军人身份。

etymology.historical_story: The international word veteran ultimately traces to Latin veteranus, associated with age and long experience, from vetus, meaning old. Malay preserves both the military meaning and the broader idea of an experienced practitioner. A veteran can therefore be a former soldier, an established sports competitor, or a seasoned performer; the surrounding words identify the intended field. [Etymology: Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/veteran).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: veteran 联想英语 veteran：军中是老兵，球场是老将，行业里是老手；共同核心是经历丰富。

morphology.pattern_note: -nya 在这里是附着于名词的代词性成分，表示他／她的视频；按模板归入 suffix。ny 读 /ɲ/，词基不变。输入包的 Jawi ۏيديو 仅对应 video；完整形式为 ۏيديوڽ。

senses.zh_definition: 他／她制作、拥有或出镜的视频、录像；具体关系由上下文确定。
senses.en_definition: His or her video recording, whether made, owned, or featured in by that person.
senses.ms_definition: Rakaman gambar bergerak, lazimnya berserta suara, yang dihasilkan oleh, dimiliki oleh atau menampilkan orang yang dirujuk oleh -nya.
senses.nuances: 这是 video 加 -nya 的组合意义，并非输入包所列的独立 DBP 释义。-nya 不标示性别，也不自动表示复数。现代 video 包括数字视频；输入包的词典释义主要描述磁带录像。来源：[DBP：video](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=113780&keyword=video)；[DBP：-nya 连写规则](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=saya+nya)。

senses.zh_definition: 他／她的录像带；用于磁带录像语境。
senses.en_definition: His or her videotape.
senses.ms_definition: Pita magnet untuk merakam gambar dan suara yang dimiliki oleh orang yang dirujuk oleh -nya.
senses.nuances: 由 DBP 所列 video 的“录像带”义与 -nya 组合而成；属于较旧的载体用法。需要清楚区分录像内容与实体磁带时，用 pita videonya 更明确。

senses.zh_definition: 他／她的录像设备；指使用录像带进行录制或播放的器材。
senses.en_definition: His or her video recording or playback equipment.
senses.ms_definition: Alat untuk merakamkan atau menayangkan rakaman melalui pita video yang dimiliki oleh orang yang dirujuk oleh -nya.
senses.nuances: 由 DBP 所列 video 的“录像设备”义与 -nya 组合而成，现今单独使用容易产生歧义。通常明确说 alat videonya，或直接说明设备种类。

etymology.historical_story: Video belongs to an international vocabulary of recorded images; its formation ultimately draws on Latin videre, meaning to see. Malay combines this borrowed base with its own grammatical resources. Adding -nya produces videonya without changing video, illustrating how a technological loanword can participate naturally in Malay reference and possession. [Sources: American Heritage](https://www.ahdictionary.com/word/search.html?q=video), [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=saya+nya).

etymology.historical_story: English vision reached the language through French, ultimately from Latin visio, associated with seeing. Its history includes imagined or supernatural scenes as well as ordinary sight. Later uses extended seeing into the future, producing the leadership sense familiar in organisational statements. etymology.historical_story: Vassili belongs to a European personal-name tradition associated with Vasili and Vasily. Related forms ultimately connect with Greek Basileios, meaning royal or kingly. Their historical meaning explains the name's ancestry, rather than giving the bearer a royal title. See [Basil: name history](https://www.behindthename.com/name/basil-1).

etymology.historical_story: Venice is an English place-name, rather than a word formed with Malay affixes. The city developed across lagoon islands and became an important maritime power. Its waterways consequently offer a useful cultural association for learners encountering the name in Malay travel writing. This historical setting explains the association with canals, not the linguistic origin of the name. [UNESCO](https://whc.unesco.org/en/list/394/)

etymology.historical_story: The full form versus comes from Latin, where it expressed being turned toward or against something. English legal writing adopted it for opposing parties, and sports writing also uses it between competitors. Malay dictionaries recognize the abbreviation vs, allowing a compact international convention to appear in local match listings and case references. [Etymonline: versus](https://www.etymonline.com/word/versus)

etymology.historical_story: Vitaly belongs to a European naming tradition rather than a Malay derivational family. The Russian masculine name Виталий appears in Roman letters as Vitaly or Vitaliy. Its ancestry is connected with Latin vita, meaning life, and the name Vitalis. Several early saints bore the name, linking its history with Christian naming traditions. Its historical meaning does not function as a Malay common-word definition. [Source: Russian Given Names](https://ans-names.pitt.edu/ans/article/download/1729/1728/3460).

etymology.historical_story: Two naming traditions can explain this spelling. Malay dictionaries record aloe vera as a complete plant name, whereas Vera also circulates internationally as a personal name. The latter has a Russian tradition meaning faith. etymology.historical_story: The cultural background of villa reaches back to Roman country estates. English Heritage describes Roman villas as rural homes belonging to people of high social status, sometimes with extensive grounds. Modern holiday accommodation retains that association with spacious living and retreat. In standard Malay, DBP records the adapted spelling vila. Sources: [English Heritage](https://www.english-heritage.org.uk/visit/places/beadlam-roman-villa/history/), [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=vila).

etymology.historical_story: English voice came through Old French vois from Latin vox, with the stem voc-. Its history connects bodily sound with the expression of opinion: a person can possess both a speaking voice and a voice in public affairs. In Malay conversation, an English expression containing voice should be distinguished from the Malay equivalent suara. [Oxford 词源](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/voice_1)

etymology.historical_story: English vervain descends from Middle English verveine through Old French, ultimately from Latin verbena, meaning leafage. Its spelling therefore preserves a European naming history rather than a Malay root-and-affix pattern. The English dictionary connects it with verbena, while botanical naming references associate vervain with Verbena officinalis and other plants, making scientific names useful companions to this common name. [American Heritage: vervain](https://ahdictionary.com/word/search.html?q=vervain); [Kew naming reference](https://mpns.science.kew.org/mpns-portal/drugDetail?drugName=vervain)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 按英语读作“VER-vayn”，重音在前；看到vervain，就联想Verbena属的马鞭草，再查学名确认种类。

senses.ms_definition: Makhluk perempuan dalam mitologi Norse yang berkhidmat kepada Odin, memilih pahlawan yang gugur dalam pertempuran dan membawa mereka ke Valhalla.

etymology.historical_story: Valkyrie ultimately comes from Old Norse valkyrja, whose elements refer to the battle-slain and choosing. The name therefore captures a specific mythological duty: selecting fallen warriors. English received the term through Old Norse and German traditions. Its historical meaning explains why translating it merely as a female warrior loses an essential part of the concept. [Source: Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/valkyrie).

etymology.historical_story: Vernon illustrates how a person's name can become a place name. According to the Canadian city's official history, the settlement was named Vernon in 1887 after Forbes George Vernon and incorporated as a city in 1892. This documented naming event explains that city's designation, without identifying which Vernon the supplied token refers to. [City of Vernon: History](https://www.vernon.ca/activities-events/museum/history-vernon)

senses.zh_definition: 真空；完全没有物质的理想空间。
senses.en_definition: A space entirely devoid of matter.

senses.zh_definition: 真空状态；气体压力较低、仍可能含有少量气体的空间或状态。

senses.ms_definition: Ruang atau keadaan yang mengandungi gas pada tekanan rendah.
senses.nuances: 常见于实验室、制造及包装技术。这里的真空不等于完全没有物质；描述实验条件时，应同时注明压力或真空等级。

senses.zh_definition: 空缺；空虚；原本应有的人、事物、作用或情感支持缺失的状态。

senses.nuances: 比喻义，可用于情感、领导或权力等抽象领域。通常比 kosong 更书面，不宜把所有普通的空位都称为 vakum。

senses.zh_definition: 真空的；涉及低气压环境，或在这种环境下运作、加工的。

etymology.historical_story: Vakum corresponds to English vacuum, whose ancestry reaches Latin vacuus, meaning empty. Malay terminology guidelines explicitly illustrate the spelling adaptation vacuum → vakum. The word connects laboratory spaces with reduced gas pressure, household cleaners, and figurative emptiness. Its everyday cleaning meaning offers a practical bridge from an abstract scientific concept to a familiar household activity. [Collins Dictionary](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/us/dictionary/english/vacuum) [DBP 术语构成指南](https://eseminar.dbp.gov.my/dokumen/umum_istilah.pdf)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 vakum，就想象空气被抽走的空间；再联想到吸尘器靠气压差产生吸力：真空、吸尘器、吸尘三个意思一起记。

etymology.historical_story: Vlad belongs to a naming tradition associated with Slavic names such as Vladislav and an element meaning to rule or control. The name also occurs in Romanian usage. When it appears in a Malay sentence, it identifies a person rather than contributing that historical meaning as a Malay vocabulary item. See [Behind the Name: Vlad](https://www.behindthename.com/name/vlad).

senses.ms_definition: Nama keluarga serta nama yang digunakan oleh perusahaan kejuruteraan British dalam sejarah dan pada produk berkaitannya.

senses.zh_definition: 用于材料检测名称的专名：维氏；维氏硬度试验利用金刚石棱锥压头形成压痕，并据压痕尺寸求取硬度。
senses.en_definition: An eponym in the name of a hardness test using a pyramidal diamond indenter and measurements of its impression.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas dalam istilah ujian kekerasan yang menggunakan penekan intan berbentuk piramid dan ukuran lekukannya untuk menentukan kekerasan bahan.
senses.nuances: Vickers 在此修饰 ujian、kekerasan 等名词；它本身不等于一般意义的“硬度”。HV 为维氏硬度符号。技术原理参见 [Struers](https://www.struers.com/en/knowledge/hardness-testing/vickers)。

etymology.historical_story: Vickers illustrates how a family name can become an industrial name. BAE Systems traces the business to Naylor, Vickers and Company in 1828, when Edward Vickers joined an existing Sheffield enterprise. The name subsequently appeared across engineering businesses. In materials testing, Vickers also identifies a particular hardness method, rather than an everyday descriptive Malay word. [BAE Systems history](https://www.baesystems.com/heritage/page/vickers-shipbuilding), [Struers](https://www.struers.com/en/knowledge/hardness-testing/vickers)

etymology.historical_story: Stephenie Meyer originally planned to place her ruling vampire clan in an invented Tuscan town called Volturin. After writing the scene, she found the real town of Volterra on a map and discovered that its clock tower matched her imagined setting. This explains the setting's development, but does not independently establish the linguistic derivation of Volturi. [Author's account](https://stepheniemeyer.com/2009/11/new-moon-qa-with-stephenie/)

etymology.historical_story: Vanessa has a literary history rather than a Malay derivational history. etymology.historical_story: Municipal records trace the French place-name to Vilcenna, originally the name of a forest. Across the Atlantic, Vincennes in Indiana developed around a French trading post associated with François-Marie Bissot, Sieur de Vincennes. The shared spelling therefore carries distinct geographical histories, and the deeper ancient derivation should not be presented as certain. [Municipal history](https://www.vincennes.fr/sites/default/files/2025-02/PLU%201-1-Diagnostic.pdf), [US National Park Service](https://www.nps.gov/parkhistory/online_books/gero/gero_clr.pdf)

etymology.historical_story: Vajra is a Sanskrit term associated with the thunderbolt and diamond. Its imagery connects irresistible force with indestructibility. In tantric Buddhist ritual, the vajra is commonly paired with a bell, giving a physical form to religious ideas about enlightenment. A bronze example from tenth-century Java illustrates its historical presence in Southeast Asia. [Metropolitan Museum of Art](https://www.metmuseum.org/art/collection/search/39090)

etymology.historical_story: Vaughn is a spelling variant of Vaughan. Welsh surname research connects Vaughan with fychan, a mutated form of bychan, meaning small or younger. Such a descriptive addition could distinguish people sharing a name before becoming hereditary. That historical meaning does not make modern bearers' names translatable adjectives. See [FamilySearch](https://www.familysearch.org/en/surname?surname=vaughn) and [Prys Morgan's surname study](https://www.snsbi.org.uk/Nomina_articles/Nomina_10_Morgan.pdf).

etymology.historical_story: Valhalla ultimately comes from Old Norse Valhöll, combining words for those slain in battle and a hall. The familiar form passed through New Latin. Its name preserves a specific mythological image: fallen heroes received by Odin in a great hall, rather than an unrestricted destination for everyone who dies. [American Heritage Dictionary](https://www.ahdictionary.com/word/search.html?q=Valhalla)

etymology.historical_story: English virgin came through Old French virgine from Latin virgo, with the stem virgin-. Its meanings now extend beyond people to untouched forests, unused materials and unrefined oils. These extensions connect different contexts through the idea of something not previously subjected to a particular experience or process. Malaysian product labels often preserve the English expression. See [Oxford: word origin](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/virgin_2).

etymology.historical_story: Vikram is associated with Sanskrit vikrama, a word encompassing a step or stride, strength, and heroism. That combination offers a memorable cultural image: someone striding forward courageously. When the name appears in Malay, however, it identifies a person; its Sanskrit associations do not create an additional Malay common-noun sense meaning courage. [Sanskrit dictionary](https://www.sanskrit-lexicon.uni-koeln.de/scans/BENScan/BENScanpdf/ben-0846.pdf)

senses.en_definition: A respectful Tamil greeting meaning hello or greetings, usable at any time of day.
senses.ms_definition: Ungkapan sapaan hormat dalam bahasa Tamil yang bermaksud salam sejahtera dan boleh digunakan pada bila-bila masa.
senses.nuances: 实际词类为感叹词或问候表达；因指定枚举不含 interjection，归入 particle。它是泰米尔语表达，在马来西亚多语交流中可以嵌用，不应自动认定为标准马来语普通词；status 按指定格式填写。问候功能与适用时间见 [Michigan State University 的泰米尔语教材](https://openbooks.lib.msu.edu/basictamil/chapter/chapter-2-1/)；所列音标为 [泰米尔语读音](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/வணக்கம்)。

etymology.historical_story: In Tamil cultural practice, vanakkam expresses respect as well as greeting. It can accompany palms brought together, though it also works over the telephone or online. In Malaysian multilingual encounters, retaining the Tamil greeting within a Malay conversation can acknowledge the other person's language while keeping the exchange accessible. [Source: Open University](https://www.open.edu/openlearn/mod/oucontent/view.php?id=109327&section=3).

etymology.historical_story: Varun belongs to a Sanskrit-derived personal-name tradition found in India. Its appearance in a Malay sentence illustrates how personal names travel between languages while retaining their identity. Here, it names a person rather than expressing an ordinary Malay dictionary meaning. The packet does not identify a particular bearer or establish that person's preferred pronunciation. See the [Varun name entry](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/Varun).

etymology.historical_story: For the Hungarian surname, the occupational origin is documented: Varga comes from a word for a shoemaker or leatherworker. A trade name thus became a family identifier, much as occupational surnames did elsewhere. This explains the surname, but it does not establish that the context-free token supplied here refers to that surname. [ELTE surname dictionary](https://v4surnames.elte.hu/index.php/sk/site/familyname?id=203)

etymology.historical_story: Vista belongs to an international family of words about seeing. Italian vista is connected with vedere, meaning to see, while English adopted vista for a view and later for an expansive mental prospect. These linked meanings offer a useful image for Malay usage: an opening in a landscape becomes an opening toward future possibilities. [Italian dictionary](https://www.treccani.it/vocabolario/vista/), [English etymology](https://www.etymonline.com/it/word/vista).

etymology.historical_story: Vivian belongs to a European personal-name tradition associated with Latin Vivianus, derived from vivus, meaning alive. Medieval records preserve related forms, showing a history older than its present international use. This background explains the name's ancestry, but it does not give every bearer a particular personality, gender, religion, or ethnic identity. [Dictionary of Medieval Names from European Sources](https://dmnes.org/2015/2/name/Vivian)

etymology.historical_story: Jules Verne was born in Nantes in 1828 and died in Amiens in 1905. Nantes preserves his memory through museum collections and accounts of the city that shaped his imagination. In a Malay discussion of his books, Verne functions as an author's surname. This is cultural context, not evidence for the surname's deeper etymology. [Nantes Métropole: Jules Verne](https://patrimonia.nantes.fr/fiches-encyclopediques/jules-verne-1828-1905/)

morphology.pattern_note: 国际科学单位整词借入。依输入及 DBP 的 [vot] 标音，读作单音节，书写中的 l 不单独发音；所给 Jawi 字符及空格原样保留。

senses.en_definition: The SI derived unit of electric potential, potential difference and electromotive force, equal to one joule per coulomb; symbol V.
senses.ms_definition: Unit terbitan SI bagi keupayaan elektrik, beza keupayaan dan daya gerak elektrik, bersimbol V; satu volt bersamaan satu joule per coulomb.
senses.nuances: DBP 收录此词并标音 [vot]。输入释义中的 tenaga elektrik 不宜直接当作严格物理定义：volt 衡量电势差等量，能量单位则是 joule。马来语数字后单位名称不加英语复数 -s。[DBP：volt](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=123312&keyword=volt)；[IUPAC：volt](https://goldbook.iupac.org/terms/view/V06634)

etymology.historical_story: The volt honours Alessandro Volta, the Italian physicist associated with the invention of the first battery. The unit received his name in 1881. Malay uses the same international unit name, connecting classroom measurements with the history of electrical science. The name is written volt, while its symbol is the capital letter V. [MIT: Alessandro Volta](https://lemelson.mit.edu/resources/alessandro-volta); [NIST: electrical units](https://www.nist.gov/pml/owm/si-units-electric-current)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: volt 就是“伏特”，记住大写 V。把电压想成推动电荷的压力：volt 量电势差，ampere 量电流，watt 量功率。

etymology.historical_story: Vadim is a masculine name used in Russian, written Вадим in Cyrillic. Its deeper origin is uncertain: accounts connect it with the saintly name Bademus, a Slavic verb, or a Norse source. These competing explanations should remain alternatives. When the name appears in Malay communication, it identifies a person rather than introducing a Malay word meaning 'ruler' or 'fighter'. [Source](https://www.behindthename.com/name/vadim)

etymology.historical_story: Vila belongs to the international villa word family. English villa comes from Italian villa, continuing a Latin term for a country house or farm. That background helps explain the association with spacious residences away from city centres. Malay uses the adapted spelling vila; the precise route of borrowing should not be inferred from spelling alone. [Etymonline](https://www.etymonline.com/word/villa)

etymology.historical_story: Vortigern belongs to Britain's early medieval historical tradition, rather than to inherited Malay vocabulary. His name is commonly interpreted through Brittonic elements meaning over and lord. Later Welsh tradition knows him as Gwrtheyrn. Accounts of Saxon settlement and dramatic legends accumulated around him, making the name a reminder that historical memory can preserve both evidence and storytelling. [Name study](https://www.vortigernstudies.org.uk/artwho/name.htm), [Welsh biography](https://www.biography.wales/article/s-GWRT-HEY-0400.html)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Vortigern 记成“古代不列颠故事中的统治者”；名称常释为“上位的领主”。这是专名联想，不是马来语构词规则。

etymology.historical_story: Under the numeral interpretation, vi belongs to Roman notation rather than Malay vocabulary. V represents five and the following I adds one. cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 正式初次接触可用 Encik Vishal；若对方有职衔或偏好的称呼，按其实际身份称呼。不要仅凭姓名推断国籍、宗教或族群。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 尊重姓名持有人的拼写与读音。资料键保留小写 vishal，正常行文写 Vishal；不为它生造马来语派生词。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 正式初次接触可用 Encik Vishal；若对方有职衔或偏好的称呼，按其实际身份称呼。不要仅凭姓名推断国籍、宗教或族群。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 尊重姓名持有人的拼写与读音。资料键保留小写 vishal，正常行文写 Vishal；不为它生造马来语派生词。

etymology.historical_story: Vishal is associated with Sanskrit viśāla, whose recorded meanings include spacious, broad, large and eminent. The Sanskrit dictionary also documents its use in names. This background helps explain the name's semantic associations, but does not establish how any particular bearer received it or make it an ordinary Malay adjective. Source: [Monier-Williams, viśāla](https://www.sanskrit-lexicon.uni-koeln.de/scans/MWScan/MWScanpdf/mw0990-vizalyaya.pdf).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Vishal 记成名牌上的整个人名；“宽广”只是其梵语背景联想，遇到本人仍直接称 Vishal。

morphology.formula: video call / video conference / venture capital / vice-chancellor → VC
morphology.pattern_note: 按字母名称逐个读出，不按普通词的音节拼读。is_root 表示本条不作词缀拆分，并不表示它是马来语固有词根。

senses.zh_definition: 视频通话；在会议语境中也可指视频会议。
senses.en_definition: A video call or, in meeting contexts, a video conference.
senses.ms_definition: Singkatan bahasa Inggeris bagi panggilan video atau persidangan video, mengikut konteks.
senses.nuances: 聊天中的 vc 常指 video call；机构文件中的 VC 也可指 video conference。两者相关，但不能脱离语境任意互换。以下释义为语境归纳，并非 DBP 独立词头释义。[霹雳州议会记录中的 video call 用例](https://dewan.perak.gov.my/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/PERSIDANGAN-KEEMPATMESYUARAT-PERTAMA-TAHUN-KEEMPAT-30-OGOS-2021.pdf)、[MOTAC 视频会议用例](https://motac.gov.my/images/ebook/ar2020.pdf)

senses.zh_definition: 风险资本；投入具成长潜力、同时具有较高风险的企业的资本。
senses.en_definition: Venture capital: investment in businesses with substantial growth potential and investment risk.
senses.ms_definition: Modal teroka, iaitu modal yang dilaburkan dalam perniagaan berpotensi berkembang tetapi mempunyai risiko pelaburan.
senses.nuances: 财经语境通常写作大写 VC，对应 modal teroka。不能把聊天中的 vc 自动解释为风险资本。[马来西亚财政部缩略语表](https://www.mof.gov.my/portal/arkib/ekonomi/2016/akronim.pdf)

senses.zh_definition: 大学校长；英语职称 vice-chancellor 的缩写，对应马来语 naib canselor。
senses.en_definition: Vice-chancellor: the executive head of a university.
senses.ms_definition: Singkatan bahasa Inggeris bagi naib canselor, iaitu ketua eksekutif sesebuah universiti.
senses.nuances: 用于大学管理语境。马来西亚的 naib canselor 通常指大学行政首长，中文不宜按字面误译为一般意义的“副校长”。[马来亚大学校长办公室](https://www.um.edu.my/chancellery)、[USM 委员会中的 VC 用法](https://legal.usm.my/index.php/committees)

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 邀请视频通话时宜先询问对方是否方便。正式文件首次出现缩写时，先写完整术语。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 私人聊天可写 vc；正式缩写通常写 VC。它有多个释义，跨部门或跨专业交流时应说明所指。

etymology.historical_story: VC is an English initialism with several context-dependent expansions, rather than a single Malay lexical root. Malaysian institutional documents illustrate this clearly: a tourism ministry report uses it for video conferencing, while a finance ministry glossary uses it for venture capital. Its meaning therefore follows the conversation's subject. [MOTAC report](https://motac.gov.my/images/ebook/ar2020.pdf)、[Finance Ministry glossary](https://www.mof.gov.my/portal/arkib/ekonomi/2016/akronim.pdf)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 vc，先看场景：聊天想到 video call，投资想到 venture capital，大学想到 vice-chancellor。

morphology.pattern_note: 这里保留英语整词，不作马来语词缀拆分。所列 IPA 为英语读音；马来语对应形式包括 ves 和 rompi。输入未提供音节或爪夷文，保留 null。

senses.zh_definition: 英语服装词：穿在躯干上的无袖衣物，可指马甲、背心或特定用途的防护背心；具体类别由语境决定。
senses.en_definition: An English clothing term for a sleeveless garment worn on the upper body, including a waistcoat or a protective vest.
senses.ms_definition: Istilah bahasa Inggeris bagi pakaian tanpa lengan yang menutupi bahagian badan; padanan bahasa Melayunya termasuk ves dan rompi mengikut konteks.
senses.nuances: vest 在 DBP 查询结果中可作为英语源词出现，不能据此标为官方马来语词形。以下搭配展示混用英语的表达；正式马来语应选用对应术语，例如 ves keselamatan 或 rompi keselamatan，并区分反光背心与救生背心。本条仅处理服装用法，不把英语动词义移植为马来语义项。[DBP：vest 术语对照](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=vest)

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Istilah bahasa Inggeris 'vest' dipadankan dengan 'ves' atau 'rompi' mengikut konteks penggunaannya.
dual_scenarios.zh: 英语词 vest 根据使用语境，对应马来语的 ves 或 rompi。
dual_scenarios.en: The English term 'vest' is rendered as 'ves' or 'rompi' in Malay, depending on its context.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Vest kau kat kerusi tu, ambil je.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Ves kamu ada di atas kerusi itu; ambillah.
dual_scenarios.zh: 你的背心在那张椅子上，拿去吧。
dual_scenarios.en: Your vest is on that chair. Go ahead and take it.
spoken_features: vest 保留英语拼写，属于语言混用。
kat 对应 di；tu 对应 itu。
je 对应 sahaja，此处使许可语气更随意。

messages.speaker: Amir (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku nak masuk tapak, tapi vest aku kat mana?
messages.ms_standard: Saya hendak memasuki tapak pembinaan, tetapi di manakah ves keselamatan saya?
messages.zh: 我要进工地了，可我的安全背心在哪儿？
messages.en: I'm about to go onto the construction site, but where's my safety vest?

messages.ms_standard: Ves itu ada di atas kerusi di sebelah pintu. Ambillah; nama kamu sudah tertera padanya.

messages.en: It's on the chair by the door. Go ahead and take it; your name's already on it.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 服装词本身无特殊敬语要求。熟悉英语的同事之间可以混用 vest；正式说明宜采用明确的马来语术语。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于服装和工作装备交流。说明安全装备时应写清用途，避免把反光背心、救生背心和防弹背心统称后造成误解。

etymology.historical_story: English vest ultimately belongs to a European clothing vocabulary associated with Latin vestis, meaning garment. Its history connects it with Italian veste and related French forms. In Malaysian terminology, the important later development is lexical adaptation: DBP pairs English vest with Malay ves or rompi according to the field and garment intended. [Dictionary.com: vest](https://www.dictionary.com/browse/vest) [DBP terminology](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=vest)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 看见 vest，联想无袖背心；写正式马来语时，再选 ves 或 rompi。
